//: NOT a package — a MODULE-TYPE MARKER, the app/package.json pattern (nukernel/ui/ carries the same one). Everything under nukernel/audio/ is a native browser ES module, but the repo root declares "type": "commonjs", and node resolves module type from the NEAREST package.json — so without this file test/unit/nukernel.test.js could not import audio/machines.js and the pure-node machine checks (every lane a voice on every machine, byte-deterministic synthesis) would have to run in a browser, which is exactly the iteration cost they exist to end. The browser never reads it; no build step consumes it; do not add dependencies here.
name: nukernel-audio
